spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m4p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Cars, LaneLimit, BayCount
ASSUME LaneLimit \in Nat /\ BayCount \in Nat
VARIABLES waiting, washing, gone
vars == <<waiting, washing, gone>>

Init ==
    /\ waiting = {}
    /\ washing = {}
    /\ gone = {}

Idle(c) == c \notin waiting /\ c \notin washing /\ c \notin gone

Arrive(c) ==
    /\ Idle(c)
    /\ Cardinality(waiting) < LaneLimit
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<washing, gone>>

StartWash(c) ==
    /\ c \in waiting
    /\ Cardinality(washing) < BayCount
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {c}
    /\ washing' = washing \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED gone

Finish(c) ==
    /\ c \in washing
    /\ washing' = washing \ {c}
    /\ gone' = gone \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED waiting

Reenter(c) ==
    /\ c \in gone
    /\ Cardinality(waiting) < LaneLimit
    /\ gone' = gone \ {c}
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED washing

Next == \E c \in Cars : Arrive(c) \/ StartWash(c) \/ Finish(c) \/ Reenter(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected ==
    /\ Cardinality(waiting) <= LaneLimit
    /\ Cardinality(washing) <= BayCount
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {c1, c2, c3, c4}
    LaneLimit = 2
    BayCount = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line takes in cars from the street, holds them in a small waiting lane, and feeds them into a fixed number of wash bays. The waiting lane has a hard limit on how many cars it can hold, and when it is full no new car may pull in from the street -- this backpressure keeps the street from being blocked. The wash bays also number only a few, so at most that many cars can be scrubbed at once. Because cars merge in from two side ramps, the attendant may pull any waiting car into a free bay, not necessarily the one that arrived first, so the service order can differ from arrival order. When a bay finishes, the clean car leaves the lot. The manager wants a guarantee that neither the waiting lane nor the set of busy bays ever holds more cars than it physically can.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at every moment the number of cars in the waiting lane never exceeds the lane limit and the number of cars in wash bays never exceeds the bay count.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m0p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Drones, Sectors, MaxStamp
VARIABLES owners, stamp, openSet, pending
vars == <<owners, stamp, openSet, pending>>

Bump(x) == IF x < MaxStamp THEN x + 1 ELSE x

Init ==
    /\ owners = [s \in Sectors |-> {}]
    /\ stamp = [s \in Sectors |-> 0]
    /\ openSet = Sectors
    /\ pending = {}

BeginClaim(d, s) ==
    /\ s \in openSet
    /\ owners[s] = {}
    /\ <<d, s, stamp[s]>> \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {<<d, s, stamp[s]>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owners, stamp, openSet>>

CommitClaim(d, s, v) ==
    /\ <<d, s, v>> \in pending
    /\ s \in openSet
    /\ stamp[s] = v
    /\ owners[s] = {}
    /\ owners' = [owners EXCEPT ![s] = {d}]
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(v)]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {<<d, s, v>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED openSet

Release(d, s) ==
    /\ d \in owners[s]
    /\ owners' = [owners EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(stamp[s])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<openSet, pending>>

CloseSector(s) ==
    /\ s \in openSet
    /\ openSet' = openSet \ {s}
    /\ owners' = [owners EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(stamp[s])]
    /\ UNCHANGED pending

OpenSector(s) ==
    /\ s \notin openSet
    /\ openSet' = openSet \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owners, stamp, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : BeginClaim(d, s) \/ Release(d, s)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors, v \in 0..MaxStamp : CommitClaim(d, s, v)
    \/ \E s \in Sectors : CloseSector(s) \/ OpenSector(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoSlotShared ==
    \A s \in Sectors : \A d1, d2 \in owners[s] : d1 = d2
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {da, db}
    Sectors = {s1, s2}
    MaxStamp = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoSlotShared
nl:
A swarm of wildfire-surveillance drones shares a set of numbered patrol sectors. To take a sector, a drone reads the sector's current version stamp, then tries to commit itself as the owner only if the stamp has not changed in the meantime; if another drone got there first the stamp will differ and the drone must back off and retry a different sector. This optimistic scheme means several drones can be attempting the same sector, but only one write wins. The incident commander can also open or close sectors at runtime as the fire perimeter shifts, so the set of assignable sectors changes during the mission; a closed sector cannot be claimed and its owner is released. A drone may also voluntarily release a sector when it runs low on battery. Command must be sure the optimistic protocol never lets two different drones believe they own the same sector at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no patrol sector is ever recorded as owned by two different drones at the same time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m7p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Terminals
VARIABLES reg, phase, snap
vars == <<reg, phase, snap>>

Init ==
    /\ reg = {}
    /\ phase = [t \in Terminals |-> "idle"]
    /\ snap = [t \in Terminals |-> {}]

Read(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "idle"
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![t] = reg]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "trying"]
    /\ UNCHANGED reg

Commit(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "trying"
    /\ reg = snap[t]
    /\ reg' = reg \cup {t}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Retry(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] = "trying"
    /\ reg # snap[t]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, snap>>

Crash(t) ==
    /\ phase[t] \in {"idle", "trying"}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "crashed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, snap>>

Next == \E t \in Terminals : Read(t) \/ Commit(t) \/ Retry(t) \/ Crash(t)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

EveryDoneContribKept ==
    \A t \in Terminals : phase[t] = "done" => t \in reg
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Terminals = {t1, t2, t3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT EveryDoneContribKept
nl:
A car-wash chain keeps a single shared tally register recording which of its worker terminals have reported today's readiness check. Each terminal contributes its own token to the register using a compare-and-swap: it first reads a snapshot of the register, then writes back the snapshot plus its token only if the register still equals the snapshot it read. If another terminal slipped a write in between, the compare fails and the terminal must re-read and try again, so no concurrent write is ever silently overwritten. A terminal may also crash silently at any point before it has committed, in which case it simply never contributes. Management wants a guarantee that the register never loses a contribution: once a terminal has successfully committed and considers itself done, its token is present in the register and stays there.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every terminal that has finished committing has its token recorded in the shared register.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m3p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Updates, None
VARIABLES leader, live, applied, acked, pending
vars == <<leader, live, applied, acked, pending>>


Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ live = Nodes
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ pending = Updates

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ n \in live
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<live, applied, acked, pending>>

Apply(u) ==
    /\ leader \in live
    /\ u \in pending
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {u}
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {u}
    /\ pending' = pending \ {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, live>>

Fail ==
    /\ leader \in live
    /\ live' = live \ {leader}
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, acked, pending>>

AdminAppoint(n) ==
    /\ n \in live
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<live, applied, acked, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n) \/ AdminAppoint(n)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Apply(u)
    \/ Fail
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AckedUpdatesDurable == acked \subseteq applied
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
    Updates = {u1, u2}
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AckedUpdatesDurable
nl:
A blood-bank inventory is replicated across several server nodes, with one node acting as the elected leader that applies inventory updates. Each update (a unit logged in or out) is only acknowledged to the requesting clinician once the leader has applied it to the durable inventory state. If the leader node fails, it drops out of the live set and a new leader is elected from the remaining live nodes; the durable state carries across the failover untouched, so nothing already applied is lost. A privileged bank administrator may override the normal election and directly appoint any live node as leader, for instance during maintenance. The chief technologist requires that the system never loses an acknowledged update: any update that was acknowledged to a clinician remains reflected in the durable inventory state forever after.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every update that has been acknowledged to a clinician is contained in the durable applied inventory state.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m9p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots, Bays, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES claims, epoch, crashed, requests
vars == <<claims, epoch, crashed, requests>>

Valid(c) == c.ep = epoch

ClaimOn(b) == { c \in claims : c.bay = b /\ Valid(c) }

Init ==
    /\ claims = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ requests = {}

Request(r, b) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ <<r, b>> \notin requests
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {<<r, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claims, epoch, crashed>>

Grant(r, b) ==
    /\ <<r, b>> \in requests
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ ClaimOn(b) = {}
    /\ claims' = claims \cup {[robot |-> r, bay |-> b, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ requests' = requests \ {<<r, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed>>

Release(r, b) ==
    /\ [robot |-> r, bay |-> b, ep |-> epoch] \in claims
    /\ claims' = claims \ {[robot |-> r, bay |-> b, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed, requests>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claims, crashed, requests>>

Crash(r) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claims, epoch, requests>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots, b \in Bays : Request(r, b) \/ Grant(r, b) \/ Release(r, b)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Crash(r)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BayNotDoublyClaimed ==
    \A c1, c2 \in claims :
        (Valid(c1) /\ Valid(c2) /\ c1.bay = c2.bay) => c1.robot = c2.robot
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2}
    Bays = {b1, b2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BayNotDoublyClaimed
nl:
A fleet of warehouse robots shares a bank of charging bays. The controller assigns bays through numbered configuration epochs: each claim a robot makes is stamped with the epoch that was current when it was granted. Whenever the layout is reconfigured the controller advances to a new epoch, which silently invalidates every claim stamped with an older epoch. A robot claims a free bay only when no valid claim of the current epoch already covers it, then charges, then releases. A robot may crash silently, leaving a stale claim behind that the next reconfiguration will clear. The operations lead insists that within any single active epoch the allocation is conflict-free: no charging bay is ever held under two different robots' valid claims at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no charging bay is ever covered by valid current-epoch claims from two different robots simultaneously.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m6p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Techs, Lines, TTL, MaxClock, None
VARIABLES clock, leaseholder, expiry, writer
vars == <<clock, leaseholder, expiry, writer>>


Valid(l) == leaseholder[l] # None /\ expiry[l] > clock

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ leaseholder = [l \in Lines |-> None]
    /\ expiry = [l \in Lines |-> 0]
    /\ writer = [l \in Lines |-> None]

Take(t, l) ==
    /\ ~Valid(l)
    /\ leaseholder' = [leaseholder EXCEPT ![l] = t]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![l] = clock + TTL]
    /\ writer' = [writer EXCEPT ![l] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Commit(t, l) ==
    /\ Valid(l)
    /\ leaseholder[l] = t
    /\ writer' = [writer EXCEPT ![l] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseholder, expiry>>

AdminRevoke(l) ==
    /\ leaseholder' = [leaseholder EXCEPT ![l] = None]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![l] = 0]
    /\ writer' = [writer EXCEPT ![l] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ writer' = [l \in Lines |-> IF expiry[l] <= clock + 1 THEN None ELSE writer[l]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseholder, expiry>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Techs, l \in Lines : Take(t, l) \/ Commit(t, l)
    \/ \E l \in Lines : AdminRevoke(l)
    \/ Tick
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyLeaseHolderCommits ==
    \A l \in Lines : writer[l] # None => (Valid(l) /\ leaseholder[l] = writer[l])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Techs = {t1, t2}
    Lines = {L1, L2}
    TTL = 2
    MaxClock = 3
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyLeaseHolderCommits
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker guards each refrigerated stock line with a lease. A technologist must hold a valid, unexpired lease on a stock line before committing any change to it. Leases carry an expiry deadline measured on a shared clock, and once the clock passes the deadline the lease is stale and confers no authority. When a stock line is free a technologist may take a fresh lease on it. A privileged bank administrator may forcibly revoke any lease -- for recall or audit -- returning the line to the free state. A change that a technologist commits marks the line as dirty under that technologist's name. The compliance officer requires that any stock line showing an uncommitted-by, that is, any dirty line, was last written by the technologist who currently holds its valid lease; no stale or unauthorized technologist may have left the last change.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every stock line marked dirty was written by the technologist currently holding that line's valid unexpired lease.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m5p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Players, Coordinators, Quorum, None
VARIABLES pool, matched, proposal, votes, crashed
vars == <<pool, matched, proposal, votes, crashed>>


Init ==
    /\ pool = Players
    /\ matched = {}
    /\ proposal = None
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

Propose(p) ==
    /\ proposal = None
    /\ p \in pool
    /\ proposal' = p
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, matched, crashed>>

CastVote(co) ==
    /\ proposal # None
    /\ co \notin crashed
    /\ co \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {co}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, matched, proposal, crashed>>

CommitSeat ==
    /\ proposal # None
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ pool' = pool \ {proposal}
    /\ matched' = matched \cup {proposal}
    /\ proposal' = None
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Dissolve(p) ==
    /\ p \in matched
    /\ matched' = matched \ {p}
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes, crashed>>

Crash(co) ==
    /\ co \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {co}
    /\ votes' = votes \ {co}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, matched, proposal>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Propose(p) \/ Dissolve(p)
    \/ \E co \in Coordinators : CastVote(co) \/ Crash(co)
    \/ CommitSeat
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PlayersConserved ==
    /\ pool \cup matched = Players
    /\ pool \cap matched = {}
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {p1, p2, p3}
    Coordinators = {c1, c2, c3}
    Quorum = 2
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PlayersConserved
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby is run by a set of coordinator nodes that must agree, by quorum vote, before any player is moved from the open waiting pool into a formed match. To seat a player a coordinator first proposes it; other coordinators cast approving votes, and only once a quorum of votes is reached does the seating commit, moving that player out of the pool and into the matched set. A matched player may later be returned to the pool when a match dissolves. Coordinator nodes can crash silently, which just removes their voting power and can stall progress but never corrupts state. The platform owner cares that players are conserved: every player registered at the start is, at all times, in exactly one of the waiting pool or the matched set, with none duplicated across both and none lost or invented.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the waiting pool and the matched set always partition the full player roster with no overlap and nothing missing.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m3p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Panels, Total, None
VARIABLES leader, live, atEntry, atWash, atExit
vars == <<leader, live, atEntry, atWash, atExit>>


Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ live = Panels
    /\ atEntry = Total
    /\ atWash = 0
    /\ atExit = 0

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ n \in live
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<live, atEntry, atWash, atExit>>

AdminAppoint(n) ==
    /\ n \in live
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<live, atEntry, atWash, atExit>>

Advance ==
    /\ leader \in live
    /\ atEntry > 0
    /\ atEntry' = atEntry - 1
    /\ atWash' = atWash + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, live, atExit>>

FinishCar ==
    /\ leader \in live
    /\ atWash > 0
    /\ atWash' = atWash - 1
    /\ atExit' = atExit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, live, atEntry>>

Fail ==
    /\ leader \in live
    /\ live' = live \ {leader}
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<atEntry, atWash, atExit>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Panels : Elect(n) \/ AdminAppoint(n)
    \/ Advance \/ FinishCar \/ Fail
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CarsConserved == atEntry + atWash + atExit = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Panels = {a, b, c}
    Total = 3
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CarsConserved
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line is coordinated by several control panels, one of which acts as the elected leader that alone may advance cars along the line. Cars sit at the entry, then move to the wash stage, then to the exit; the counts at these three stages together account for every car in the facility. Only the current leader panel may advance a car from entry to wash or finish a car from wash to exit. If the leader panel fails it drops from the live set and a new leader is elected from the remaining live panels. A privileged site administrator may override the election and directly appoint any live panel as leader. The owner requires strict conservation: the total number of cars in the facility never changes as they move through the stages -- no car is duplicated or lost.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of cars at entry, at wash, and at exit always sums to the fixed facility total.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m9p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Drones, Regions, Cap, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES assign, requests, epoch, activeSet
vars == <<assign, requests, epoch, activeSet>>

Init ==
    /\ assign = [g \in Regions |-> {}]
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ activeSet = {}

Placed(d) == \E g \in Regions : d \in assign[g]

Request(d, g) ==
    /\ ~Placed(d)
    /\ <<d, g>> \notin requests
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {<<d, g>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, epoch, activeSet>>

Dispatch(d, g) ==
    /\ <<d, g>> \in requests
    /\ ~Placed(d)
    /\ Cardinality(assign[g]) < Cap
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![g] = assign[g] \cup {d}]
    /\ requests' = requests \ {<<d, g>>}
    /\ activeSet' = activeSet \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Leave(d, g) ==
    /\ d \in assign[g]
    /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![g] = assign[g] \ {d}]
    /\ activeSet' = activeSet \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<requests, epoch>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ assign' = [g \in Regions |-> {}]
    /\ activeSet' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED requests

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones, g \in Regions : Request(d, g) \/ Dispatch(d, g) \/ Leave(d, g)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RegionWithinCapacity == \A g \in Regions : Cardinality(assign[g]) <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2, d3}
    Regions = {g1, g2}
    Cap = 1
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RegionWithinCapacity
nl:
A wildfire drone swarm is partitioned across several observation regions, and the mission planner limits how many drones may loiter in any one region at once. Drones submit assignment requests into a shared request pool; the dispatcher may service these requests in any order, not necessarily the order they arrived, pulling any pending request and placing that drone into its region provided the region is below its drone cap. A drone may leave its region, freeing a slot. Periodically the mission is reconfigured under a new epoch number, which clears all current region assignments and starts placement afresh. The safety engineer requires that the drone cap on every region is honored at all times: no region ever holds more drones than its capacity permits.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of drones assigned to any region never exceeds that region's fixed capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od8m6p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
CONSTANTS Students, Seats, TTL, MaxClock, None
VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, ledger, crashed
vars == <<clock, holder, expiry, ledger, crashed>>


Valid(s) == holder[s] # None /\ expiry[s] > clock

Enrolled(st) == \E i \in DOMAIN ledger : ledger[i] = st

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = [se \in Seats |-> None]
    /\ expiry = [se \in Seats |-> 0]
    /\ ledger = << >>
    /\ crashed = {}

Hold(st, se) ==
    /\ st \notin crashed
    /\ holder[se] = None
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![se] = st]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![se] = clock + TTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, ledger, crashed>>

Finalize(st, se) ==
    /\ holder[se] = st
    /\ Valid(se)
    /\ ~Enrolled(st)
    /\ ledger' = Append(ledger, st)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, crashed>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, ledger, crashed>>

Crash(st) ==
    /\ st \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {st}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, ledger>>

Next ==
    \/ \E st \in Students, se \in Seats : Hold(st, se) \/ Finalize(st, se)
    \/ \E st \in Students : Crash(st)
    \/ Tick
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

EnrollAtMostOnce ==
    \A i, j \in DOMAIN ledger : ledger[i] = ledger[j] => i = j
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Students = {s1, s2}
    Seats = {e1, e2}
    TTL = 2
    MaxClock = 2
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT EnrollAtMostOnce
nl:
A university course-registration system hands each student a time-limited hold (lease) on a seat before the student can finalize enrollment. A hold carries an expiry deadline on a shared clock; past the deadline the hold is stale and grants no right to finalize. Finalizing enrollment is irreversible -- it appends the student to a permanent enrollment ledger -- and must happen at most once per student. A student may only finalize while holding a valid, unexpired seat hold, and only if not already present in the ledger. Students may crash silently, abandoning a held seat before finalizing. The registrar requires that the permanent ledger never records the same student twice: each irreversible enrollment happens at most one time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no student appears more than once in the permanent enrollment ledger.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m4p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Workers, Requests, QueueCap, None
VARIABLES queue, mode, holding, done
vars == <<queue, mode, holding, done>>


Init ==
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ mode = [w \in Workers |-> "idle"]
    /\ holding = [w \in Workers |-> None]
    /\ done = {}

Enqueue(rq) ==
    /\ rq \notin queue
    /\ rq \notin done
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < QueueCap
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {rq}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, holding, done>>

Enter(w, rq) ==
    /\ mode[w] = "idle"
    /\ rq \in queue
    /\ \A x \in Workers : mode[x] # "critical"
    /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![w] = "critical"]
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![w] = rq]
    /\ queue' = queue \ {rq}
    /\ UNCHANGED done

Leave(w) ==
    /\ mode[w] = "critical"
    /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ done' = done \cup {holding[w]}
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![w] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED queue

Requeue(rq) ==
    /\ rq \in done
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < QueueCap
    /\ done' = done \ {rq}
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {rq}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mode, holding>>

Next ==
    \/ \E rq \in Requests : Enqueue(rq) \/ Requeue(rq)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, rq \in Requests : Enter(w, rq)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Leave(w)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtMostOneInSection ==
    \A w1, w2 \in Workers :
        (mode[w1] = "critical" /\ mode[w2] = "critical") => w1 = w2
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Workers = {w1, w2}
    Requests = {q1, q2}
    QueueCap = 1
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AtMostOneInSection
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby feeds join requests through a bounded intake queue into a single match-forming core. The intake queue has a hard size cap, and when it is full new join requests are refused -- backpressure that protects the core. Worker threads pull requests from the queue in any order, not strictly first-in-first-out, so servicing can be reordered. The match-forming core is a critical section that only one worker may occupy at a time; a worker must find the core free before it may enter while holding a request, and it releases the core when done. The engineer requires strict mutual exclusion on the match-forming core: at no time may two different workers be inside it simultaneously.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one worker is ever inside the match-forming critical section at any moment.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m6p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Residents, Locks, Controllers, TTL, MaxClock, None
VARIABLES clock, holder, deadline, openBy
vars == <<clock, holder, deadline, openBy>>


Valid(l) == holder[l] # None /\ deadline[l] > clock

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = [l \in Locks |-> None]
    /\ deadline = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
    /\ openBy = [l \in Locks |-> None]

Grant(ct, r, l) ==
    /\ ct \in Controllers
    /\ ~Valid(l)
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![l] = r]
    /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![l] = clock + TTL]
    /\ openBy' = [openBy EXCEPT ![l] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Open(r, l) ==
    /\ Valid(l)
    /\ holder[l] = r
    /\ openBy' = [openBy EXCEPT ![l] = r]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, deadline>>

Close(r, l) ==
    /\ openBy[l] = r
    /\ openBy' = [openBy EXCEPT ![l] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, deadline>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ openBy' = [l \in Locks |-> IF deadline[l] <= clock + 1 THEN None ELSE openBy[l]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, deadline>>

Next ==
    \/ \E ct \in Controllers, r \in Residents, l \in Locks : Grant(ct, r, l)
    \/ \E r \in Residents, l \in Locks : Open(r, l) \/ Close(r, l)
    \/ Tick
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyValidHolderOpens ==
    \A l \in Locks : openBy[l] # None => (Valid(l) /\ holder[l] = openBy[l])
====
nl:
A neighborhood of smart door locks is managed by two independent controller instances that both draw from one shared pool of locks. To use a lock a resident first obtains a time-limited lease from either controller; the lease names the resident as holder and carries an expiry deadline on a shared clock. Only the current holder of an unexpired lease may throw a lock open. As the clock advances a lease can pass its deadline and become stale, after which the holder is no longer authorized and any open the resident still had is cleared. Either controller may grant a fresh lease on a lock that is free, and because the two controllers share one pool they must not both hand out a live lease on the same lock. The security team needs assurance that no lock is ever held open by a resident who is not its current authorized, unexpired lease holder.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every lock that is currently open is open under the name of the lock's present unexpired lease holder.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m2p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Locks, Cap
VARIABLES armed, phase, votes, batch
vars == <<armed, phase, votes, batch>>

Init ==
    /\ armed = {}
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ votes = [l \in Locks |-> "none"]
    /\ batch = {}

Propose(S) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ S \subseteq Locks
    /\ S # {}
    /\ \A l \in S : l \notin armed
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ batch' = S
    /\ votes' = [l \in Locks |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED armed

VotePrepare(l) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ l \in batch
    /\ votes[l] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![l] = "prepared"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<armed, phase, batch>>

VoteAbort(l) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ l \in batch
    /\ votes[l] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![l] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<armed, phase, batch>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A l \in batch : votes[l] = "prepared"
    /\ Cardinality(armed) + Cardinality(batch) <= Cap
    /\ armed' = armed \cup batch
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ batch' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E l \in batch : votes[l] = "aborted"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ batch' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<armed, votes>>

AdminDisarm(l) ==
    /\ l \in armed
    /\ armed' = armed \ {l}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, batch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E S \in SUBSET Locks : Propose(S)
    \/ \E l \in Locks : VotePrepare(l) \/ VoteAbort(l) \/ AdminDisarm(l)
    \/ Commit \/ Abort
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ArmedWithinBudget == Cardinality(armed) <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Locks = {la, lb, lc}
    Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ArmedWithinBudget
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network arms locks in coordinated batches using two-phase commit. A coordinator proposes a batch of locks to arm; each participant lock votes to prepare or abort; only if all vote to prepare does the coordinator commit and the batch becomes armed, otherwise the batch is aborted. The home has an energy budget that caps how many locks may be armed at once, so a batch may only commit if arming it keeps the total number of armed locks within the cap. A privileged home administrator may forcibly disarm any lock to free capacity. The installer requires that the arming budget is never exceeded: at no point are more locks armed than the configured cap.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of locks in the armed state never exceeds the configured arming budget.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m0p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cranes, Ships, MaxStamp
VARIABLES stamp, dispatched, count, attempt
vars == <<stamp, dispatched, count, attempt>>

Bump(x) == IF x < MaxStamp THEN x + 1 ELSE x

Init ==
    /\ stamp = [s \in Ships |-> 0]
    /\ dispatched = {}
    /\ count = [s \in Ships |-> 0]
    /\ attempt = {}

BeginDispatch(c, s) ==
    /\ s \notin dispatched
    /\ <<c, s, stamp[s]>> \notin attempt
    /\ attempt' = attempt \cup {<<c, s, stamp[s]>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stamp, dispatched, count>>

CommitDispatch(c, s, v) ==
    /\ <<c, s, v>> \in attempt
    /\ stamp[s] = v
    /\ s \notin dispatched
    /\ dispatched' = dispatched \cup {s}
    /\ count' = [count EXCEPT ![s] = count[s] + 1]
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(v)]
    /\ attempt' = attempt \ {<<c, s, v>>}

RetryStale(c, s, v) ==
    /\ <<c, s, v>> \in attempt
    /\ stamp[s] # v
    /\ attempt' = attempt \ {<<c, s, v>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stamp, dispatched, count>>

Reclaim(s) ==
    /\ s \in dispatched
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(stamp[s])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dispatched, count, attempt>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Ships : BeginDispatch(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Ships, v \in 0..MaxStamp : CommitDispatch(c, s, v) \/ RetryStale(c, s, v)
    \/ \E s \in Ships : Reclaim(s)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ShipDispatchedOnce == \A s \in Ships : count[s] <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {k1, k2}
    Ships = {sa, sb}
    MaxStamp = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ShipDispatchedOnce
nl:
A container-ship crane yard dispatches each ship exactly once. To dispatch a ship a crane controller reads the ship's version stamp, prepares the manifest, then commits the irreversible dispatch only if the stamp is unchanged since it read it; if a slow controller's stamp is stale the commit fails and it must retry. Controllers may be slow -- taking arbitrarily long between reading and committing -- but they do not fail outright. Dispatching is irreversible and, per port rules, each ship must be dispatched at most once; a ship already dispatched has its stamp advanced so no lingering attempt can dispatch it again. The harbor master requires the guarantee that no ship is ever dispatched more than one time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: each ship is recorded as dispatched at most one time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od13m5p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Machines, Slots, Quorum, None
VARIABLES grant, proposer, votes
vars == <<grant, proposer, votes>>


Init ==
    /\ grant = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ proposer = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ votes = [s \in Slots |-> {}]

OpenProposal(m, s) ==
    /\ grant[s] = None
    /\ proposer[s] = None
    /\ proposer' = [proposer EXCEPT ![s] = m]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED grant

CastVote(m, s) ==
    /\ proposer[s] # None
    /\ grant[s] = None
    /\ m \notin votes[s]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = votes[s] \cup {m}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, proposer>>

GrantSlot(s) ==
    /\ grant[s] = None
    /\ proposer[s] # None
    /\ Cardinality(votes[s]) >= Quorum
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![s] = proposer[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposer, votes>>

Withdraw(s) ==
    /\ grant[s] = None
    /\ proposer[s] # None
    /\ proposer' = [proposer EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED grant

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines, s \in Slots : OpenProposal(m, s) \/ CastVote(m, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : GrantSlot(s) \/ Withdraw(s)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SlotSingleWinner ==
    \A s1, s2 \in Slots :
        (s1 = s2 /\ grant[s1] # None /\ grant[s2] # None) => grant[s1] = grant[s2]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Machines = {m1, m2, m3}
    Slots = {sl1, sl2}
    Quorum = 2
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SlotSingleWinner
nl:
A network of vending machines coordinates the allocation of scarce restock slots through quorum voting. When a machine wants a restock slot it opens a proposal for that slot; peer machines cast approving votes, and the slot is granted to the proposer only once a quorum of votes backs that specific proposal. A machine may be slow -- its votes and proposals can lag -- but machines do not fail. Only one machine may ultimately be granted any given slot; a fresh proposal for an already-granted slot cannot be opened. The regional manager requires that a restock slot is never granted to two different machines: each slot has at most one winner.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no restock slot is ever granted to two different vending machines.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m2p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Tasks, Drones
VARIABLES pool, prepared, assigned, phase
vars == <<pool, prepared, assigned, phase>>

AllAssigned == UNION { assigned[d] : d \in Drones }

Init ==
    /\ pool = Tasks
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ assigned = [d \in Drones |-> {}]
    /\ phase = "idle"

Propose(S) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ S \subseteq pool
    /\ S # {}
    /\ prepared' = S
    /\ pool' = pool \ S
    /\ phase' = "prepared"
    /\ UNCHANGED assigned

CommitTo(d) ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![d] = assigned[d] \cup prepared]
    /\ prepared' = {}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED pool

AbortBatch ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ pool' = pool \cup prepared
    /\ prepared' = {}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED assigned

CrashDrone(d) ==
    /\ assigned[d] # {}
    /\ pool' = pool \cup assigned[d]
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![d] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prepared, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E S \in SUBSET Tasks : Propose(S)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CommitTo(d) \/ CrashDrone(d)
    \/ AbortBatch
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TasksConserved ==
    /\ (pool \cup prepared \cup AllAssigned) = Tasks
    /\ pool \cap prepared = {}
    /\ pool \cap AllAssigned = {}
    /\ prepared \cap AllAssigned = {}
====
nl:
A wildfire drone swarm reassigns surveillance tasks in atomic batches via two-phase commit. Each task lives in exactly one place: the unassigned pool, a committed assignment to a drone, or an in-flight prepared batch. A coordinator proposes moving a set of pooled tasks to a drone; drones prepare, and the coordinator either commits the whole batch (moving those tasks from pool to assigned) or aborts it (returning them to the pool). A drone may crash silently, which releases its committed tasks back to the pool rather than losing them. The mission accountant requires strict conservation of tasks: every task is always accounted for in exactly one location, with none created or destroyed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the pool, the prepared batch, and the assigned tasks always partition the full task set with no task lost or duplicated.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od11m5p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Jobs, Replicas, Cap, Quorum
VARIABLES waiting, printing, finished, votes
vars == <<waiting, printing, finished, votes>>

Init ==
    /\ waiting = Jobs
    /\ printing = {}
    /\ finished = {}
    /\ votes = [j \in Jobs |-> {}]

Vote(r, j) ==
    /\ j \in waiting
    /\ r \notin votes[j]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![j] = votes[j] \cup {r}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, printing, finished>>

Admit(j) ==
    /\ j \in waiting
    /\ Cardinality(votes[j]) >= Quorum
    /\ Cardinality(printing) < Cap
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {j}
    /\ printing' = printing \cup {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<finished, votes>>

Complete(j) ==
    /\ j \in printing
    /\ printing' = printing \ {j}
    /\ finished' = finished \cup {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, votes>>

Resubmit(j) ==
    /\ j \in finished
    /\ finished' = finished \ {j}
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {j}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![j] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED printing

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Replicas, j \in Jobs : Vote(r, j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Admit(j) \/ Complete(j) \/ Resubmit(j)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ActivePrintsBounded == Cardinality(printing) <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Jobs = {j1, j2, j3}
    Replicas = {r1, r2}
    Cap = 2
    Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ActivePrintsBounded
nl:
A print-shop job spooler admits jobs to the printers only by quorum agreement among its scheduler replicas, and it caps how many jobs may be actively printing at once. When a job is at the head candidates, scheduler replicas vote to admit it; the job starts printing only after a quorum votes yes and only if the active-print count is below the cap. Replicas may be slow -- their votes can arrive late -- but they do not fail. A printing job eventually finishes, freeing a slot. The shop owner requires that the number of jobs simultaneously printing never exceeds the printer capacity cap.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of jobs actively printing never exceeds the printer capacity cap.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m3p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Nodes, Rooms, MaxCap, None
VARIABLES leader, live, booked, cap
vars == <<leader, live, booked, cap>>


Card(S) == Cardinality(S)

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ live = Nodes
    /\ booked = {}
    /\ cap = 1

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ n \in live
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<live, booked, cap>>

Fail ==
    /\ leader \in live
    /\ live' = live \ {leader}
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, cap>>

Book(rm) ==
    /\ leader \in live
    /\ rm \notin booked
    /\ Card(booked) + 1 <= cap
    /\ booked' = booked \cup {rm}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, live, cap>>

Release(rm) ==
    /\ rm \in booked
    /\ booked' = booked \ {rm}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, live, cap>>

Recap(k) ==
    /\ k \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ k >= Card(booked)
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, live, booked>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E rm \in Rooms : Book(rm) \/ Release(rm)
    \/ \E k \in 1..MaxCap : Recap(k)
    \/ Fail
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BookingsWithinCapacity == Cardinality(booked) <= cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    Rooms = {o1, o2, o3}
    MaxCap = 3
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BookingsWithinCapacity
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler is coordinated by a set of controller nodes, one the elected leader that alone may book operating rooms. There is a live cap on how many rooms may be booked concurrently, and this cap can change at runtime as staffing fluctuates -- but it never drops below the number already booked. Only the current leader may add a booking, and only while the booked count stays within the current cap. If the leader fails a new leader is elected from the remaining live nodes. Bookings may be released. The chief of surgery requires that the number of concurrently booked operating rooms never exceeds the current capacity cap.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of booked operating rooms never exceeds the current capacity cap.

    MaxStamp = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next

nl:
A smart-home door-lock network limits how many locks may be held open at once to conserve the door-controller's power budget. Residents request opens into a shared pool, and the controller may service those requests in any order, not the order they arrived. To open a lock the controller uses optimistic concurrency: it reads the lock's version stamp and only opens if the stamp is unchanged and the open budget is not yet full; otherwise the attempt is stale and must be retried. Opening a lock advances its stamp. Locks can be closed again, freeing budget and advancing the stamp. The homeowner requires that the number of simultaneously open locks never exceeds the power-budget cap.

    /\ p \in wants
    /\ onRunway = {}
    /\ onRunway' = {p}
    /\ wants' = wants \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, passes>>

    /\ onRunway' = onRunway \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, wants, passes>>

    /\ passes < MaxPasses

    /\ passes' = passes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRunway, wants>>

cfg_text:

    Positions = {a, b, c}
    MaxPasses = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OneRunwayUser
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator grants exclusive use of a runway via a circulating token on a ring of tower positions. Only the position currently holding the token may enter the runway (the critical section); it releases the runway before passing the token to the next position on the ring. Two independent tower instances share the same physical runway pool but coordinate through the single token, so the token is the sole authority to occupy the runway. A holder may pass the token without entering. The safety authority requires strict mutual exclusion on the runway: never may two tower positions occupy the runway at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one tower position is on the runway at any instant.

---- MODULE W4Od1m9p0t3 ----

    /\ <<fl, epoch>> \notin grants

CONSTANTS
    Flights = {u1, u2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RunwayMutex
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator grants exclusive runway occupancy and periodically reconfigures its allocation policy under a new epoch number. A flight may enter the runway only by presenting a grant stamped with the current epoch and only when the runway is unoccupied; a reconfiguration bumps the epoch and invalidates outstanding grants, so a slow flight holding an old-epoch grant cannot enter. Flights may be slow but do not fail. A flight leaves the runway when done, freeing it. The safety board requires strict mutual exclusion: at most one flight occupies the runway at any time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one flight is on the runway at any instant.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m6p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Controllers, Feeders, TTL, MaxClock, MaxAuth, None
VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, tripped, authCap
vars == <<clock, holder, expiry, tripped, authCap>>


Valid(f) == holder[f] # None /\ expiry[f] > clock

Leased == { f \in Feeders : holder[f] # None }

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = [f \in Feeders |-> None]
    /\ expiry = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
    /\ tripped = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
    /\ authCap = 1

Grant(c, f) ==
    /\ holder[f] = None
    /\ Cardinality(Leased) < authCap
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![f] = c]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![f] = clock + TTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, tripped, authCap>>

Trip(c, f) ==
    /\ Valid(f)
    /\ holder[f] = c
    /\ tripped[f] = 0
    /\ tripped' = [tripped EXCEPT ![f] = 1]
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![f] = None]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![f] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, authCap>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, tripped, authCap>>

Recap(k) ==
    /\ k \in 1..MaxAuth
    /\ authCap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, tripped>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Feeders : Grant(c, f) \/ Trip(c, f)
    \/ \E k \in 1..MaxAuth : Recap(k)
    \/ Tick
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TripAtMostOnce == \A f \in Feeders : tripped[f] <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2}
    Feeders = {f1, f2}
    TTL = 2
    MaxClock = 2
    MaxAuth = 2
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TripAtMostOnce
nl:
A power-grid load shedder trips feeders to shed load during emergencies. Before a controller may trip a feeder it must hold a valid, unexpired authority lease on that feeder, granted on a shared clock; past its deadline the lease is stale and confers no right. Tripping a feeder is irreversible for the event and must happen at most once per feeder -- once tripped, the feeder is logged and its lease cleared so no second trip can occur. The total shed authority (how many feeders may currently hold live leases) can change at runtime as grid conditions evolve. The grid operator requires that no feeder is ever tripped more than once during the event.
SAFETY PROPERTY: each feeder is tripped at most one time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od8m6p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Advisors, Files, Changes, TTL, MaxClock, MaxLease, None
VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, durable, acked
vars == <<clock, holder, expiry, durable, acked>>


Valid(f) == holder[f] # None /\ expiry[f] > clock

Leased == { f \in Files : holder[f] # None }

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = [f \in Files |-> None]
    /\ expiry = [f \in Files |-> 0]
    /\ durable = {}
    /\ acked = {}

Take(a, f) ==
    /\ holder[f] = None
    /\ Cardinality(Leased) < MaxLease
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![f] = a]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![f] = clock + TTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, durable, acked>>

Commit(a, f, ch) ==
    /\ Valid(f)
    /\ holder[f] = a
    /\ durable' = durable \cup {ch}
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {ch}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

Release(f) ==
    /\ holder[f] # None
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![f] = None]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![f] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, durable, acked>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, durable, acked>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Advisors, f \in Files : Take(a, f) \/ Release(f)
    \/ \E a \in Advisors, f \in Files, ch \in Changes : Commit(a, f, ch)
    \/ Tick
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CommittedGradesDurable == acked \subseteq durable
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Advisors = {a1, a2}
    Files = {f1, f2}
    Changes = {g1, g2}
    TTL = 2
    MaxClock = 2
    MaxLease = 2
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CommittedGradesDurable
nl:
A university course-registration system lets advisors commit grade-change records under time-limited leases on each student file. An advisor must hold a valid, unexpired lease on a file before committing a change; once a change is committed and acknowledged to the advisor it is durably recorded and must never be lost, even as leases turn over. Leases expire as the shared clock advances. The number of files that may be simultaneously leased can change at runtime as staffing varies. When a lease is free an advisor may take it; a committed record is added to the durable set and simultaneously acknowledged. The registrar requires that every acknowledged grade change remains in the durable record forever after.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every acknowledged grade-change record is contained in the durable committed set.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m2p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Calls, Cars, None
VARIABLES pending, phase, proposal, times, crashed
vars == <<pending, phase, proposal, times, crashed>>


Init ==
    /\ pending = Calls
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ proposal = None
    /\ times = [k \in Calls |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

Propose(k, car) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ k \in pending
    /\ car \notin crashed
    /\ proposal' = <<k, car>>
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, times, crashed>>

Prepared ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ proposal[2] \notin crashed
    /\ phase' = "prepared"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, proposal, times, crashed>>

CommitDispatch ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ times' = [times EXCEPT ![proposal[1]] = times[proposal[1]] + 1]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {proposal[1]}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ proposal' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

AbortOnCrash ==
    /\ phase \in {"voting", "prepared"}
    /\ proposal[2] \in crashed
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ proposal' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, times, crashed>>

Crash(car) ==
    /\ car \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {car}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, phase, proposal, times>>

Next ==
    \/ \E k \in Calls, car \in Cars : Propose(k, car)
    \/ \E car \in Cars : Crash(car)
    \/ Prepared \/ CommitDispatch \/ AbortOnCrash
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DispatchOncePerCall == \A k \in Calls : times[k] <= 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Calls = {h1, h2}
    Cars = {e1, e2}
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DispatchOncePerCall
nl:
An elevator bank dispatches hall calls to cars using two-phase commit so that each call is served by exactly one car. A dispatcher proposes assigning a pending call to a car; the car votes to prepare, and the dispatcher then commits, irreversibly marking that call dispatched to that car -- an action that must happen at most once per call. If a car crashes silently during voting the proposal is aborted and the call returns to pending, never having been dispatched. A committed call is recorded permanently. The building manager requires that no hall call is ever dispatched more than once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: each hall call is committed as dispatched at most one time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m8p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Techs, None
VARIABLES coarse, fine, writer
vars == <<coarse, fine, writer>>

Bays == {1, 2}
Nozzles == {1, 2, 3, 4}
BayOf(n) == IF n \in {1, 2} THEN 1 ELSE 2

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [b \in Bays |-> None]
    /\ fine = [n \in Nozzles |-> None]
    /\ writer = [n \in Nozzles |-> None]

AcquireCoarse(t, b) ==
    /\ coarse[b] = None
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, writer>>

AcquireFine(t, n) ==
    /\ coarse[BayOf(n)] = t
    /\ fine[n] = None
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![n] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, writer>>

WriteSetting(t, n) ==
    /\ coarse[BayOf(n)] = t
    /\ fine[n] = t
    /\ writer' = [writer EXCEPT ![n] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseFine(t, n) ==
    /\ fine[n] = t
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![n] = None]
    /\ writer' = [writer EXCEPT ![n] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED coarse

ReleaseCoarse(t, b) ==
    /\ coarse[b] = t
    /\ (\A n \in Nozzles : BayOf(n) = b => fine[n] # t)
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, writer>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Techs, b \in Bays : AcquireCoarse(t, b) \/ ReleaseCoarse(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Techs, n \in Nozzles : AcquireFine(t, n) \/ WriteSetting(t, n) \/ ReleaseFine(t, n)
    \/ UNCHANGED vars

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyProperlyLockedWrites ==
    \A n \in Nozzles :
        writer[n] # None =>
            (fine[n] = writer[n] /\ coarse[BayOf(n)] = writer[n])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Techs = {t1, t2}
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyProperlyLockedWrites
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line protects its configuration with hierarchical locks: before a technician may adjust a specific nozzle (a fine-grained resource) they must first hold the coarse lock on the whole bay that contains it, and then the fine lock on that nozzle. Lock requests from multiple technicians arrive into a shared pool and may be granted in any order. A technician may only write a nozzle's setting while holding both the enclosing bay's coarse lock and that nozzle's fine lock; a technician without the proper lock chain is unauthorized and must not leave a setting. Locks can be released. The maintenance lead requires that every nozzle showing a pending setting was written by a technician who at that time properly held both the bay's coarse lock and the nozzle's fine lock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every nozzle with a written setting was set by a technician who holds both the enclosing bay's coarse lock and that nozzle's fine lock.
